risk_if_not_implemented: Without Predictive Maintenance, the organization's understanding of the threat environment may become stale, leaving defenses misaligned with active adversary tactics. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Software & Firmware Patching
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct software patching for all deployed Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), including firmware.
compensating_control_1.justification: Software & Firmware Patching (VPM-08) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Predictive Maintenance (MNT-06) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Timely Maintenance
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) within a defined Recovery Time Objective (RTO).
compensating_control_2.justification: Timely Maintenance (MNT-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Predictive Maintenance (MNT-06) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
